note: 0.6 (Osama, 7 November 2026). Artillery penetration +50%: every tube, mortar and rocket artillery round (trajectory 20, 30, 40) whose penetration FA lowered below vanilla gets its FA value x1.5, never above its vanilla value (60 rows; for example 155 mm HE 30 -> 45 of vanilla 75, 81 mm HE 30 -> 40 = vanilla, laser-guided 155 mm 52.5 -> 75 = vanilla). Rounds FA did not lower are unchanged. Ballistic missiles (ATACMS, PrSM, Iskander, Tochka) already have their vanilla penetration in FA and are unchanged. Not yet run in a game.
